author: Codex documentation author; corrections by DOC-029 source-review author agent (entities)

prerequisites: One fictional Entity per role with a fixture Registration; a seeded reachable Matter chosen in the dialog; fixed fictional due and filing dates.
scenarios.expected: Filing history and the next cycle follow the confirmed action and supported recurrence rule. Past-due items do not silently count as filed; invalid dates and unauthorized changes have a clear outcome.
scenarios.actual: Nadia Haddad added an annual Obligation due 2025-09-30, Repeat every (months) 12, with Registration, Assignee Nadia Haddad, a Matter and a Note, all shown on the row after a reload, and a one-off due 2026-11-20 with a blank recurrence. Recurrence 1201 kept the dialog open with "One or more request fields are invalid.", 0 kept it open with the browser's minimum message, and a blank Label did not submit; no refused Obligation was created. A Note saved on focus change and Assignee Unassigned on selection. The Due-date list showed overdue rows (severe treatment) before open future rows; Entity and Assignee with Apply left the two rows, overdue first. Month, Previous month, Next month, Today and Due-date list kept the filters. From/To narrowed to the one-off; a 2099 window showed "No obligations match" and Clear all removed the filters; the Obligation link opened the Entity's Obligations tab. Home's Entity obligations listed the overdue annual item; afterwards it was still due 2025-09-30 and still offered Mark filed. An unassigned overdue Obligation did not appear on Nadia Haddad's Home. Mark filed explained the 12-month advance, Filed on started at the browser's local date, and filing on 2026-10-05 moved the due date to 2027-09-30; History recorded "Nadia Haddad marked <label> filed on <Entity>". Filing the one-off kept 2026-11-20, showed "Filed <date>", removed Mark filed, disabled the row, and left the calendar until Include completed was turned on. A due-date correction saved on blur; clearing the date kept the saved value; Delete removed a scrap schedule without touching the annual item. Archiving the Entity removed its Obligation from Home, the calendar and the Entity filter until Restore; while archived the row was disabled and a filing request was refused with "This entity is archived. Restore it before editing.".
scenarios.stepsSummarized: 16 recorded steps for this role, all pass

Recorded against app source 3fa407e3a846559914aa1a63249741f30cfb4f69, which differs from edition.json's supportedAppCommit; the edition pin or a compatibility review is outside this walkthrough's file ownership.
API calls prepared fixtures (Entities, Holdings, Contracts, a Registration) or read back results the browser had already shown; every documented action was performed through the browser controls.

Not exercised: approaching-date reminders and the daily briefing (scheduler timing), another person's concurrent filing of a one-off, and the Administrator Home fallback for a named assignee who cannot reach a Confidential Entity. The source review records a Home fallback defect for an Administrator assignee without a Grant; the article describes the intended rule.
The 1,201-month refusal shows the generic "One or more request fields are invalid." message; zero months is stopped by the browser's minimum-value check before submission.
